apps.localizedDescription: An original four-room action roguelite prototype with directional katana combat, dash, lightning, room upgrade choices and the Hollow Bell boss. Version 0.4.0 adds original prototype sprites and simple animation/hit feedback, an English HUD, Kae experience and levels, earned coins, permanent katana upgrades and versioned local saves with reward receipts and corruption recovery. Editor scenarios and fresh native build/package checks passed. Real touch, physical iPhone/AltStore installation and device performance remain unverified. No payment SDK, account system or game server is connected.
